extra.ariaLabel: React's aria-label labels the close button; an aria-label attribute would label the notification.

extra.ariaCurrent: React's aria-current goes to the item's link, which Carbon styles as the current page; an aria-current attribute would go to the <li>.

missing.rel: A plain attribute, through `...attributes`, as on a native `<a>`.
missing.target: A plain attribute, through `...attributes`, as on a native `<a>`.

extra.autoAlign: Carbon React's Button takes `autoAlign` at runtime and passes it to the icon-only button's tooltip, though its types leave it out.

missing.downshiftProps: It isn't built on downshift, so there's nothing to pass them to.
missing.inputProps: Attributes on the component go to the input, through ...attributes.
missing.itemToElement: The default block renders each item.
